name: August Vang

kit.name: Sonic (sound sculpting)
kit.description: August hears everything and can throw it back.

moves.name: Feedback Lash
moves.description: A cutting directional shriek — the poke tool.

moves.name: Dead Air
moves.description: A silence dome: enemies inside can't call reinforcements, casters can't cast, and the fight goes eerily mute — a design showpiece.

moves.name: Bassline
moves.description: A rhythmic ground-pulse that staggers enemies on the beat and buffs squad attack speed if THEY attack on the beat.

signature.name: Encore
signature.description: Records the last 5 seconds of combat audio and replays it as concussive force — the bigger the fight was, the bigger the blast.

personality.summary: Watchful in a way people mistake for shy; devastating one-liners delivered at library volume; holds grudges in perfect fidelity because he literally cannot forget a sound.

romance.notes: Months of dry jokes across the soundboard, then one night he plays you a track made of city sounds and it's — obviously, embarrassingly — about you.

recruitHook: Friendship, not spectacle: he joins after the player does three small things quietly — no witnesses, no rep gain — and he heard every one of them.
differentiation: Dead Air is the anti-reinforcement / anti-caster tool — no other slice kit silences.
Bassline is the only squad-wide attack-speed buff and it demands rhythm play.
